subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent managed plugin installation before the full install/uninstall/update/discovery/security contract is defined, or should this PR pause until that contract is approved?
rationale: This PR changes plugin code execution scope and persisted install identity, and automation cannot choose the durable security and compatibility semantics for multi-agent plugin roots.

options.title: Pause for the full scoped-plugin contract
options.body: Define canonical record identity, target-agent validation, global-vs-agent precedence, update/uninstall/doctor/index behavior, and security policy before merging this feature.

options.title: Narrow this PR to a complete first slice
options.body: Keep the feature in this branch only if it also wires scoped uninstall/update/index behavior and proves fresh-install plus upgrade behavior within an approved boundary.

options.title: Accept partial install-only behavior
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept scoped install writes without scoped cleanup/update guarantees, but that leaves existing users exposed to orphaned records and unclear trust semantics.

recommendation.title: Pause for the full scoped-plugin contract
recommendation.body: Define canonical record identity, target-agent validation, global-vs-agent precedence, update/uninstall/doctor/index behavior, and security policy before merging this feature.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest recent history signal on the plugin install/uninstall persistence files touched by this PR.
